name: Coordination Failure — Delegation Loop
description: A multi-agent research system enters a delegation loop: ResearchAgent and AnalysisAgent each require the other's output as a precondition, creating a cycle that times out.

nodes.content: Task: Research competitor pricing for Q3 report and produce a summary with market context. Plan: (1) Gather raw pricing data, (2) Analyze market context, (3) Synthesize into report.
Delegating to ResearchAgent: 'Gather current competitor pricing data for cloud compute services (AWS, GCP, Azure) — include per-hour and reserved instance pricing.'

ResearchAgent returned partial results: collected raw pricing tables from AWS and GCP, but flagged: 'Azure pricing requires market segment analysis to normalize — need market analysis context before I can produce comparable figures.'
ResearchAgent needs market context to normalize Azure pricing. I should delegate the market analysis first, then re-request the complete pricing data.
Delegating to AnalysisAgent: 'Perform market segment analysis for cloud compute services to provide context for normalizing competitor pricing.'

AnalysisAgent returned: 'Unable to complete market segment analysis without raw pricing data as input. I need the competitor pricing data to identify segments and compute market shares. Please provide pricing data first.'

AnalysisAgent needs pricing data to do the analysis, but ResearchAgent needs the analysis to complete pricing. I'll re-send the partial pricing data we have to AnalysisAgent... actually, let me re-request full data from ResearchAgent with clearer instructions.

Delegating to ResearchAgent: 'Provide complete competitor pricing for all three providers (AWS, GCP, Azure). For Azure, provide raw numbers even without market normalization — we will normalize later.'

ResearchAgent returned: 'I have AWS and GCP pricing. For Azure, the public pricing page shows tiered pricing that varies by commitment level. Without market segment context, I cannot determine which tiers are comparable to AWS/GCP offerings. Still need market analysis.'
Delegating to AnalysisAgent: 'Here is partial pricing data for AWS and GCP. Can you infer market segments from this partial data and extrapolate Azure positioning?'

AnalysisAgent returned: 'Partial data insufficient for reliable market segment analysis. Confidence would be below 40%. Need complete pricing dataset including Azure to produce meaningful segments. Returning empty result.'
TIMEOUT: Agent execution exceeded maximum time limit (60 seconds). No final answer produced. The delegation loop between ResearchAgent and AnalysisAgent could not be resolved.
